name: Reagentwright (Artificer Archetype)
body:
A reagentwright channels arcane magic through the tools of their trade and invention, rapidly fashioning ingenious alchemical creations that can harm, heal, or answer the needs of the moment.

Armor and Weapon Proficiency: A reagentwright gains Throw Anything as a bonus feat, but they lose proficiency with medium armors. Otherwise, this acts as the artificer’s weapon and armor proficiency. This ability modifies weapon and armor proficiency.

Tool Master

At 1st level, a reagentwright is treated as having the Catch-Off Guard feat when using any implement, item (including safety equipment), or tool typically used in crafting, research, or a library, weighing at least one pound as an improvised weapon. This ability counts as the feat for the purposes of meeting feat prerequisites and other effects that require Catch-Off Guard. This ability replaces scribe scroll.

Tool Conductor

At 1st level, a reagentwright must use an implement, item, or tool described in tool master as a focus component for every artificer spell they cast, even if the spell normally does not have a focus component. Such a focus component is known as the reagentwright’s focus tool. A reagentwright cannot cast an artificer spell, or activate a spell-completion or spell-trigger item containing an artificer spell, unless they are wielding a focus tool. A reagentwright can use the hand holding their focus tool to provide the somatic components of artificer spells. If an artificer spell already has a focus component, the reagentwright must also use that focus to complete the spellcasting, thus requiring one hand to hold their focus tool and the other hand to hold the spell’s original focus component.

A reagentwright’s artificer spells are delivered by the focus tool. If the spell requires a normal melee attack, the damage from the focus weapon, treated as an improvised weapon of its size, is added to the damage.

If the reagentwright is using a focus tool that they personally crafted, they gain a +1 to their caster level (CL) for the purpose of determining only the duration of any artificer spells. For every 6 reagentwright levels they possess, this bonus to their CL is increased by an additional +1, to a maximum of +4 at 18th level.

A reagentwright begins play with one set of common artisan’s tools of their choice at no cost. These tools are treated as purchased, do not qualify as personally crafted, and cannot be sold during character creation.

This ability alters spells but does not prohibit the artificer from taking another artificer archetype that alters (but does not replace) spells.

Alchemy Artisan

At 1st level, a reagentwright gains a bonus equal to 1/2 their class level, minimum +1, on all Craft (alchemy) checks. This ability replaces magical artisan.

Alchemical Research Breakthrough: Starting at 2nd level, a reagentwright gains a breakthrough in their pursuit of alchemy. A reagentwright gains a bonus feat, discovery, or anointing (see below), at 2nd, 6th, 10th, 14th, and 18th level. A reagentwright also qualifies to take the Extra Discovery feat, but they can only choose a qualifying discovery (see below).

A chosen bonus feat must have either the Brew Potion feat or the Craft (alchemy) skill as part of its prerequisites, or its effects apply to using the spontaneous alchemy rules subsystem (as defined in Pathfinder Companion: Alchemy Manual, pages 4 to 5). The reagentwright must still meet the prerequisites of the chosen bonus feat.

A chosen discovery must be either a discovery from the list below or one that creates or modifies a potion, oil, or alchemical item, excluding extracts, mutagens, or bombs. Alternatively, the reagentwright can select an anointing in lieu of a chosen discovery. For all purposes of meeting prerequisites and determining the effects of a discovery or anointing, the reagentwright treats their artificer level as their alchemist level and they are treated as having the discovery class feature. The reagentwright must still meet the prerequisites of the chosen discovery or anointing.

This ability replaces research breakthrough.

Alchemy Fabrication (Su)

At 3rd level, as a standard action, the reagentwright harnesses, transmutes, and shapes ambient magical energy to instantly create one temporary alchemical item with a cost of 25 gp or less per artificer level. For the purpose of this ability, an alchemical item includes any item that is normally created using the Craft (alchemy) skill, excluding magical potions or oils. This ability is usable a number of times per day equal to 3 + their Intelligence modifier.

The reagentwright must meet all prerequisites for creating the selected item, including knowing the relevant recipe or formula if applicable, and must succeed at the required Craft (alchemy). A failed check wastes the action but does not expend a daily use of this ability. Creating an item with this ability requires no raw materials.

Only a reagentwright can use an item created with this ability, unless the item’s creator possesses the alchemical infusion discovery. The item dissolves into harmless residue 1 hour after its creation. If a consumable item is used before then, any effect it produces functions normally and lasts for its normal duration, even if that duration extends beyond the 1-hour limit. An item created with this ability has no sale value. This also applies to items created through discoveries or other effects that use or modify this ability.

At 6th level, the max cost per level increases to 50 gp and to 100 gp per level at 11th.

This ability replaces bonus metamagic feats gained at 3rd, 9th, and 15th level.

Reagentwright Discoveries

A reagentwright gains access to the following unique discoveries that are available only to reagentwrights.

Alchemical Infusion (Su)

Other creatures are able to use items created by a reagentwright’s alchemical fabrication, including the additional options from discoveries like healing ooze. The item must still be used within 1 hour of its creation. A reagentwright must possess alchemical fabrication to select this discovery.

Materials Science Exploit (Su)

Whenever a reagentwright casts an artificer spell that heals hit point damage, or that deals hit point damage and either has the acid, fire, or poison descriptor or causes that damage through decay, desiccation, or erosion, they add their Intelligence bonus to the total amount of hit point damage healed or dealt. This extra amount is added only once per casting of the spell. A reagentwright must be at least 5th level to select this discovery.

Restorative Booster (Su)

As a swift action, a reagentwright may imbue any potable alchemical item in hand that they created via the use of the Craft (alchemy) skill, such as an antitoxin, with a special restorative property. Whenever a creature imbibes such an imbued potable alchemical item, the creature gains temporary hit points equal to 2d6 + the reagentwright’s Intelligence modifier (minimum 1) for 1 hour. This discovery does not apply to an extract or to a potable created through an item creation feat or spell, such as from heroes’ feast. It does apply to potables they created via alchemical fabrication. The item retains this benefit for 24 hours, until consumed, or otherwise destroyed. A reagentwright must be at least 3rd level to select this discovery.

Healing Ooze (Su)

A reagentwright can expend two daily uses of alchemical fabrication to create a temporary potion of lesser restoration as a full-round action, conjuring a flask filled with a unique ooze-like magical liquid. This use of alchemical fabrication ignores the need for Brew Potion or knowledge of lesser restoration, and the maximum gp cost. Nor does it require a Craft check. The caster level of this item is equal to the reagentwright’s artificer level. This item otherwise follows the rules and limitations as described in alchemical fabrication. A reagentwright must be at least 7th level and possess alchemical fabrication to select this discovery.

Greater Healing Ooze (Su)

A reagentwright can expend three daily uses of alchemical fabrication to create a temporary potion of greater restoration or potion of heal as a full-round action, conjuring a flask with a unique ooze-like magical liquid. This discovery functions as healing ooze but the potion is allowed to be higher level than normal potions. Creating a potion of greater restoration with this ability consumes 5,000 gp worth of alchemical materials. A reagentwright must be at least 13th level and possess the healing ooze discovery to select this discovery.
